🇲🇳 Would you survive a Mongolian winter? 🥶
Mongolia looks like a land of absolute freedom — endless steppe, wild horses, traditional gers, and a sky with no limits. But behind that freedom is one of the harshest climates on Earth, where a brutal zud can threaten an entire family’s livelihood.
If you could spend 30 days living in Mongolia, which would you choose?
🐎 Life with a nomadic family
🏙 Life in Ulaanbaatar
🐪 Life in the Gobi Desert
🦅 Life as an eagle hunter
Tell us your choice and the country you're watching from! 🇺🇸🌎
And if you enjoyed this journey through Mongolia, subscribe to Amazing Discoveries Top US for more incredible stories about how people live around the world.
